## 问题与结果

说明用户遇到的问题，以及修改后的具体行为。

## 验证

- 执行的构建/检查：
- UI 截图或录屏（如适用）：
- 模型假设、参考来源和验证限制（如适用）：

## 提交前

- [ ] 已阅读相关 README 和 AGENTS.md。
- [ ] 源码与生成网页一致，相关检查通过。
- [ ] 未提交凭据、临时文件或无关改动。
- [ ] 已更新受影响的说明、路由或许可信息。

## English — pull request summary

- Problem and resulting user-visible behavior:
- Build/check commands executed:
- UI screenshots or recordings, when applicable:
- Scientific assumptions, primary references and verification limitations:

### Before submitting

- [ ] Read the applicable README and AGENTS.md.
- [ ] Keep source and generated pages consistent; relevant checks pass.
- [ ] Exclude credentials, temporary files and unrelated changes.
- [ ] Update affected bilingual documentation, routes and license information.
